nonResident.copy: Without Dutch residency, zorgtoeslag usually does not apply. The flow will keep the estimate honest and avoid implying guaranteed entitlement.

housingSimplified.title: Housing questions simplified.
housingSimplified.noRentalContract: Without a rental contract, the wizard does not ask for detailed huurtoeslag rent values.
housingSimplified.noIndependentHome: Without an independent home, huurtoeslag is unlikely, so we skip rent questions that would not change the outcome.

healthBlocked.title: Health check shortened.

noInsurance.title: Zorgtoeslag remains unlikely in the current scenario.
noInsurance.copy: Dutch basic health insurance is normally required. The result will show this clearly together with the next documentary step.

noChildren.title: Children section simplified.
noChildren.copy: With no children under 18, child benefit and childcare questions are skipped.

noChildcare.title: Childcare section shortened.
noChildcare.copy: No childcare support was marked as relevant, so the wizard skips provider and invoice details.

nextSteps.collectHealthPolicy: Prepare your health insurance policy details and recent income evidence before filing.
nextSteps.reviewHealthConditions: Review residency and health insurance status first, then reassess the estimate.
nextSteps.prepareRentalDocuments: Prepare the rental contract, rent amount and address registration documents.
nextSteps.reviewHousingConditions: Clarify whether the home is independent and whether a rental contract can be documented.
nextSteps.confirmChildBenefit: Confirm kinderbijslag status and gather the child-related support documents.
nextSteps.reviewChildrenConditions: Check child benefit status and the age or registration details for the children involved.
nextSteps.prepareChildcareInvoices: Prepare childcare invoices, provider registration details and work-status evidence.
nextSteps.reviewChildcareConditions: Check whether childcare is registered, paid and linked to qualifying work or status.
